twit-mcp 1.0.1

- Real-time access to X/Twitter data using x402 micropayments; no API keys needed.
- Supports user lookups, bulk user/tweet fetching, tweet search, and following/follower queries.
- Each API call triggers an automatic, per-request USDC microtransaction with payment handled securely via your own wallet.
- Runs locally with simple node install and wallet key configuration.
- Full documentation and tool listing provided in SKILL.md.
